title: Planet Saturn
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 12 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Saturn as the lord of luck, darkness and things: what to leave alone, the Saturn stone, serving the blind, sade sati and a worked chart.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 12, Planet Saturn by Brajesh Gautam: luck and the dark areas, remedies, the Saturn stone, sade sati and Q&A, with video timestamps.
points: It sits where you cannot see. Poke that area and it turns on you.
Do not boast, count, announce or keep asking in a Saturn area. Ask once and leave it to a guru.
A guru in any form sets Saturn. Ego brings Jupiter down on you.
Do your duty. Do not try to please them or teach them.
Serve the blind, give in secret.
Feed the blind, tula daan, blind donation, a lamp at the peepal.
Blue sapphire only after the checks on sign 10 and house 8, and not on one placement.
Sade sati depends on the whole chart.
Rama and Ravana had it together with opposite results.
puts: <h3>The tug of war: Sun, Jupiter, Saturn
